remarks:
1) TO ALL WHOM IT MAY CONCERN: Notice is given that the U.S Army Corps of Engineers Pittsburgh District will be closing the 110-ft x 1200-ft primary chamber at Hannibal Locks and Dam. The closure will start Tuesday, October 12th at 0700 EST and last for four (4) weeks through Tuesday, November 10th at 0700 EST. 

 

2) The closure is required to replace the hydraulic system.

 

3) PROCEDURE: The 110-ft x 600-ft auxiliary chamber will remain open during the primary chamber closure. Self-help will be needed for multiple cuts through the auxiliary chamber. 

 

4) Mariners in the area are requested to monitor marine channel 13 for any updates or information during this closure period.

remarks:
Black Rock Lock Operations – 

November 16, 2026 - February 26, 2027 

  • A contract was awarded to replace the bushings on the east and west upper and lower miter gate hydraulic cylinders at Black Rock Lock.
  • During this time frame, beginning November 16, 2026 the lock will be unable to operate.

  • Anticipated reopening of the Black Rock Lock is March 1, 2027.

     

  • Contact the Black Rock Lock at (716) 879-4403 or email Justin.D.Heaslip@usace.army.mil for updates on when lockages will be performed at future dates.

title: Black Rock Lock - Miter Gate Bushing Replacement

remarks:
Notice is given that “Mulzer Crushed Stone, Inc.” will commence dredging at Ohio River Miles 752 & 756 near Owensboro, KY.  Work will occur October 12-16, 2026.  Hours of work will be 0700 to 1600 CT.

    

The contractor’s floating plant will consist of a crane on a barge and one additional barge for material.  Marine channel 10 will be monitored.
